title: What Makes a Good Diffusion Planner for Decision Making?

layout.note: Two panels side by side with large serif letters: (a) is a vertical flow of noise grid, orange network box and plan grid with the dataset frame at the left, a pose strip and a robot illustration below; (b) is four small trees scattered in the panel (planning strategy top right, backbone upper middle, action generation lower middle, guided sampling right), each with a coloured root and white option boxes.

lesson: Lay out a design space as small trees with one colour per component, white option boxes outlined in that colour and a red star on the preferred choice, and repeat the component colours on the pipeline drawing beside it so each choice can be located.
